title: Frequency-aware Feature Fusion for Dense Image Prediction
mechanism: Decoder feature fusion with an adaptive low-pass filter (consistent interiors), offset resampling, and an adaptive high-pass filter (restores boundary detail lost in downsampling).
adaptation: Replace the upsample + concat at each U-Net++ decoder node with FreqFusion on 1-channel EL features. The low-pass is meant for blobby inactive regions, the high-pass for 1 to 2 px crack edges.
min_experiment: Arm: PF + FreqFusion decoder, 5-fold CV. Baseline: PF. Metric: inactive IoU and crack IoU. Kill: both < 1 SE.
evidence: R: gains on semantic, instance and panoptic segmentation and detection (abstract). No thin-structure numbers seen.
